sources.entry: RustRover - A brand new JetBrains IDE for Rust Developers.

summary.name: RustRover
summary.one_liner: RustRover is JetBrains' dedicated IDE for Rust development, offering coding assistance, debugging, testing, Cargo integration and version control in one environment.
use_cases: working with Git, GitHub or GitLab from an IDE
summary.what_it_does: The page describes RustRover as a Rust IDE with context-aware code completion, on-the-fly analysis, quick-fixes and smart refactorings. It includes syntax highlighting for inferred types, macros and unsafe code, plus documentation lookup and code search. Tests can be run individually, by module or project-wide, with custom Run configurations for CLI apps, and a debugger is included. It offers a Cargo tool window, TOML editing with Cargo integration, a built-in HTTP Client, Docker and database tooling, and collaboration features such as real-time code sharing and Git, GitHub and GitLab support.
notable: Free for non-commercial use with the same full-featured IDE as the paid version
Built-in HTTP Client, Docker tool and database tooling, with WebStorm web features and DataGrip database tools included
Automatically adds new files to main.rs and popular crates to Cargo.toml dependencies
caveats: Commercial use requires a paid commercial subscription
On the non-commercial tier, detailed code-related data (edit history, terminal usage, AI interactions) is collected by default and must be disabled manually in settings
Telemetry is sent to JetBrains on the non-commercial tier
